RL run diagnostics

positional arguments:
  {bnorm,rollouts,select-frontier}
    bnorm               LoRA A/B Frobenius norms of an adapter; --ref flags a
                        dead run
    rollouts            reward histogram, per-task pass@k, zero-variance
                        groups
    select-frontier     write frontier_selection.json with tasks inside the
                        pass-rate band

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
